query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `creative_memory` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `org_id` int NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int,
  `selected_asset_id` int,
  `preferred_style` varchar(100),
  `preferred_size` varchar(50),
  `preferred_colors` varchar(255),
  `preferred_layout` varchar(100),
  `successful_prompt_keywords` text,
  `feedback_type` varchar(50),
  `feedback_note` text,
  `program_context` varchar(100),
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_creative_memory_org` (`org_id`),
  INDEX `idx_creative_memory_user` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_creative_memory_style` (`org_id`, `preferred_style`)
);
